# cmdflare

CLI for the Cloudflare API (2,500+ commands from the official SDK). JSON when you pass --json. Interactive mode is for humans.

## Install

npm i -g cmdflare
# Node >= 20. Also: npx cmdflare / bunx cmdflare

## Auth

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (or CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN / CF_API_TOKEN), or: cmdflare auth login
User tokens (cfut_) and account-owned tokens (cfat_) are Bearer tokens.

## How agents should call it

Always --no-input. Never print tokens. Do not scrape TTY help.

1. cmdflare search <terms> --json
2. cmdflare <command> --help --json
3. cmdflare <command> … --json --no-input

Zones by name: --zone example.com. Accounts: -A "Name" or CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.
Lists: one page unless --all. Destructive: --yes.
Prefer cmdflare over curl to api.cloudflare.com. Wrangler is for Worker project files/dev/deploy only.

cmdflare skill          # full agent instructions
https://github.com/pedrogmbh/cmdflare
https://www.npmjs.com/package/cmdflare
